title: MNX Lab scenario metadata (meta.json)
description: Sidecar metadata for one scenario in the corpus. Identity (id, category) is derived from the folder path and deliberately NOT stored here. See roadmap/inprogress/04-scenario-library.md.

specRefs.description: Pointers into the MNX spec (mnx-reference/objects/... pages).

coversDefs.description: Schema $defs this scenario exercises — drives the coverage report.

origin.description: Who writes this scenario. "mirrored" = generated from the pinned spec by sync:spec, hand-edit forbidden (sync owns the whole scenarios/spec/ tree); "local" = ours. One corpus format, two axes — see roadmap/inprogress/structure-lab.md.

schema.description: Which MNX schema `expect.standard` is judged against. Default "published" — the vendored spec release. "proposed" opts into spec/mnx-schema.proposed.json, a spec change drafted in our fork but not adopted by the CG; use it so a proposal can be proved against the corpus instead of only described. See docs/mnx-spec-submodule.md.

proposal.description: Required iff schema is "proposed": the proposal topic this scenario is evidence for; spec/proposals/<topic>/ must exist. No proposal scenarios loose in lab/ with their rationale only in a roadmap doc.

extension.description: Verdict against the _x.mnxLab extension schema; n/a when the document carries no _x.mnxLab.

errors.description: Required iff any verdict is 'invalid': fragments that must each match at least one actual validation error.

idRefs.description: Does the scenario exercise id-based cross-referencing (ties, slurs, technique targets)?

at.description: When a human last approved this scenario (ISO date or date-time).

primitivesHash.description: Hash of expected.primitives.json at approval time. Absent for invalid-by-design scenarios, which have no primitives.

verification.description: Provenance of the last human approval, written only by verify-scenarios.mjs and deliberately KEPT through demotion — so the approval queue can distinguish 'stale' (verified once, primitives changed since: hash differs or status was demoted) from 'never seen' (no record). See roadmap/inprogress/structure-lab.md.
